'''Prototype B-16''' was a prototype [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] designed by the [[Schism Collective]] for the [[New Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the later stages of the [[Battle of Ilum]], it and its counterpart, [[Prototype A-14]], were destroyed aboard the [[Emperor's Fortress]]. Standing far taller than the average being, the two wielded [[Electrostaff/Legends|electrostaffs]] and a powerful shield that could be transferred between them.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Prototypes B-16 and A-14 appears as bosses in the Flashpoint "The False Emperor" in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which was released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
